claims.note: IE-CoR documents Middle English fir as an earlier form of fire, rebutting the earlier claim that fir is arbitrary truncation. Words descend from modern fire (firing/fired drop written e before suffix; other words contain fire). Accept as verified historical variant retrieval only; the e in fire belongs to the modern base, and fir tree is a different homograph. Gunfire/misfire extend the fire sense.
